findings.title: Bullet margin-top removed and line-height added to whole extra-info wrapper without justification
findings.body: In the `.extra-info-wrapper` rule, the `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` block for `.badge-wrapper` is deleted, and `line-height: 1.5` is added to the wrapper itself. The removed rule vertically offset bullet badges in this area, and nothing replaces it. The line-height now applies to every descendant, not just badges, so text and other children in this header area can shift height. The PR is about flexbox layout, so these visual changes look unintended and are not covered by the description.

findings.title: `.title` float rule deleted from header without replacement
findings.body: The `.d-header .title { float: left; }` rule is removed and nothing takes its place. If any header markup still uses a `.title` element, it loses its left placement. Under the new flex container, floats on flex items are ignored anyway, so the only way the element keeps its position is through the flex order. The author should confirm no header element depends on `.title` or add an explicit replacement.

findings.title: Flexbox on .small-action makes its float-based children and clear ineffective, with padding removed
findings.body: `.small-action` becomes a flex container, but its children still rely on floats: `.topic-avatar { float: left }`, `.small-action-desc .avatar { float: left }`, and `button { float: right }`. Floats are ignored on flex items, so these no longer behave as before. The `clear: both` on the container is also meaningless for a flex container. In addition, the `.small-action-desc` vertical padding and the 4em left padding (which reserved room for the avatar) were removed and replaced with `padding: 0 1.5%`, and the `margin-top: 5px` and `padding-top: 4px` were dropped. The left-side space that was reserved for the avatar now depends entirely on flex sizing, so this is a visible layout change in small action posts that needs visual verification.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid or misapplied vendor properties
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a real property and is never valid. It also emits `-webkit-box-align` alongside `-webkit-align-items`, which only has an effect on `display: -webkit-box` containers. Since `.contents` and `.small-action` use the modern `display: flex` value, the old-spec properties are dead code. These are harmless in most browsers but are misleading and should be removed or corrected.

findings.title: PR description is uninformative and performance claim is unsupported
findings.body: The PR description is just 'Test 5', so a reviewer gets no rationale for changing layout from floats to flexbox across header, topic, post and badge styles. The title says 'Optimize ... performance', but no measurement or reasoning is given, and the change is mainly a visual layout rewrite. Without the rationale, reviewers cannot judge the trade-offs or what visual regressions are expected.
